meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 引导一次可中断、可续做的数据迁移:把经典单机器人 Slack 安装改成每个 agent group 一个独立的 slack-<slug> 机器人,保留身份、workspace、记忆与接线行为;也可选择留在经典模式并记录该决定。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示 Slack agents 要求时触发,也可之后随时单独运行。

say.text: 帮我把经典 Slack 迁移成每个 agent 一个机器人
say.note: 先检测经典状态,再让你选择

say.text: 先给我看 dry-run 映射表,我确认后再动手
我不迁移,留在经典 Slack,记录这个决定
say.note: 不改动,经典 Slack 照常工作

howto.what_en: Guides a resumable, operator-led migration from classic single-bot Slack to one slack-<slug> bot per agent group, preserving identities, workspaces, memory and wiring — or records your choice to stay classic.
howto.when_en: Triggers when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or you can run it standalone at any time later.

say_en.text: Migrate my classic Slack agents to one bot per agent group
say_en.note: Checks classic state, then offers the choice

say_en.text: Show me the dry-run map before changing anything
Stay on classic Slack and record that decision
say_en.note: Nothing changes; classic Slack keeps working
